name: Tambo del Inka, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa, Valle Sagrado
insider_take: Nestled in the heart of Peru's Sacred Valley at 9,500 feet above sea level, this luxury retreat serves as the perfect base camp for Machu Picchu adventures while offering direct access to ancient Incan terraces and ruins.
whats_special: The resort sits on the original grounds of a 16th-century Inca settlement and features its own private train station - the only hotel in the Sacred Valley with direct PeruRail access to Machu Picchu. The property's unique location allows guests to explore pre-Columbian agricultural terraces right from their doorstep, while the on-site Kiri Spa incorporates ancient Andean healing traditions with coca leaf treatments.
pro_tip: Book the Machu Picchu package that includes the private train departure directly from the hotel - you'll skip the crowded Ollantaytambo station and enjoy a seamless journey to the ancient citadel with priority boarding.
dont_miss: The resort's archaeological walk through original Inca ruins and terraces, plus the sunset views from the outdoor infinity pool overlooking the Urubamba River. The local Pisac Market (20 minutes away) offers authentic textiles and crafts, while the nearby Maras salt mines showcase 500-year-old harvesting techniques still used today.
pros: Strategic Sacred Valley location perfect for Machu Picchu exploration
Luxury resort amenities including world-class spa and fine dining
Authentic Andean cultural experiences and local immersion
Premium Marriott STARS program benefits and service standards
cons: High altitude location may require acclimatization
Remote Sacred Valley setting with limited nearby amenities
